Title: Verify today's earnings reflect payments made on the same day
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner with at least one order that has a payment recorded today
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Dashboard screen.
2. Locate the 'Today's Earnings' card in the financial summary section.
3. Note the amount displayed under 'Today's Earnings'.
4. Open the Payments screen and filter payments by today's date.
5. Sum the amounts of all payments listed for today.

Test Data: Use an order with a payment of 500 BDT made today
Expected Result: The 'Today's Earnings' amount on the Dashboard matches the total sum of payments recorded for today in the Payments screen.

Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner with at least two orders having unpaid balances (due amounts > 0)
Steps:

3. Note the amount displayed under 'Total Due'.
4. Open the Orders screen and filter orders by 'Unpaid' status.
5. Sum the 'Due Amount' of all unpaid orders listed.

Test Data: Use two orders with due amounts of 200 BDT and 300 BDT respectively
Expected Result: The 'Total Due' amount on the Dashboard matches the total sum of due amounts from all unpaid orders.

Title: Verify total earnings reflect the sum of all payments received this month

Expected Result: The 'Earning This Month' amount on the Dashboard matches the total sum of payments recorded for the current month.

Title: Empty shop with zero orders returns zero instead of null for all monetary summary fields
Preconditions: A shop exists and the authenticated owner is logged in. The shop has no orders or payments recorded.
Steps:
1. Authenticate as the shop owner. 2. Call the dashboard summary endpoint GET /api/dashboard/summary. 3. Inspect each monetary field in the response data.

Test Data: Shop with zero orders, zero payments
Expected Result: All monetary fields return BigDecimal 0.00 instead of null: earningToday=0.00, totalDue=0.00, totalEarning=0.00, totalOrderAmount=0.00, earningThisMonth=0.00. Before the COALESCE change, these fields would have returned null for an empty result set.

Title: Orders exist but none created today - earningToday correctly shows zero via Payment table

Steps:

Expected Result: earningToday=0.00 (no new payments today). The new Payment-based calculation only sums payments with paymentDate=today, excluding the yesterday order's paidAmount. Before this change, earningToday would have been null.

Title: Exact same-day date range boundary - BETWEEN start AND end returns same result as equality for earningToday
Preconditions: A shop exists with at least one payment recorded today. The authenticated owner is logged in.
Steps:
1. Create an order today with paidAmount=250.00. 2. Call GET /api/dashboard/summary. 3. Note earningToday value. 4. Manually verify that sumTotalCollectedAmountBetweenDates(today, today) equals sumTotalCollectedAmountByDate(today).

Test Data: Order created today with paidAmount=250.00, paymentDate=today
Expected Result: earningToday=250.00. The BETWEEN query (today, today) and the date-equality query both return the same single-day sum.

Title: Month boundary for earningThisMonth - orders from previous months excluded from current month total
Preconditions: A shop exists with orders from last month (with paidAmount). The authenticated owner is logged in. Today is the first day of a new month.
Steps:
1. Verify an order exists from last month with paidAmount=500.00. 2. Create no orders this month yet. 3. Call GET /api/dashboard/summary. 4. Check earningThisMonth value.

Test Data: Order from March with paidAmount=500.00, viewed on April 1st
Expected Result: earningThisMonth=0.00. The new query uses ORDER_DATE BETWEEN monthStart AND monthEnd, excluding orders from previous months. Before this change, monthlyEarning may have summed all-time paidAmount.
